experiment.topic: BTC-USD price reversion after sharp 5% drop in 20-hour window
experiment.hypothesis: After a 5% price drop within a 20-hour window, BTC-USD will revert to its prior price level within the next 24 hours with a probability greater than 70% based on 1-hour close data.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: No price reversion event occurs within 24 hours after a 5% drop in BTC-USD price, as defined by 1-hour close data, across at least 10 distinct 20-hour windows in the period 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-03.
